notes: Batch of 15 IRS-list groups. Two of two searches used. Both went to groups a newcomer could most likely join: African Immigrants Resources Center (website field was the name cut short) and International Christian Fellowship Church (website parked). Five groups were not searched because the budget ran out: Black Thornberry Inc, When You Give a Bean Water, Daughters of Destiny, Kingdom Realm Ministries, and Chelkeinu Initiative. Those five, plus African Immigrants and ICF, are held-back records with status unknown and no summary, so they will not show on the site until someone checks them. Two groups are fully researched and publishable: Lemkin Institute (judgment call: its work is global and online, and its Philadelphia address comes only from the IRS list, so please confirm it belongs in a Philadelphia directory) and Women's Nonprofit Leadership Initiative (status probably_active, but its newest dated item is a 2024 year with no month). Fetches used: 25 of 60. No rate limiting: the failures were 404s, a 500, and parked or redirected domains. Three are out of area (Task Brasil, Theta, Keren Ezra). Two are hidden as private (Tequila That Cares Foundation, and To the Moon and Back Michael D Mooney Jr Foundation) and one as defunct (Wings for Success, merged into The Wardrobe, a Philadelphia-headquartered group now in leads_only).
